printed_sign_assessment: Row by row from the page: yes. printed_sign.printed_signs reads, for each ix:nonFraction InvestmentOwnedAtCost / AtFairValue fact, whether the cell text immediately before ends with '(' and after starts with ')', keyed by context and concept, and flips the record only where that disagrees with the sign attribute, the magnitude matches, and all printings agree; it is gated to the three listed accessions. Source reconciliation calls the same function with record_events=False, so for those facts it compares published with the same derived value: it confirms consistency, not the sign. Independent confirmation exists outside that loop: published unfunded cost / FV equal the printed unfunded subtotals in all three quarters (-478/-270, -426/-1,376, -368/-1,354k), and published FV ties to the filed investments total in all 14 quarters.
